source_evidence: Player exact 'Great then lets continue' after Elara accepts political representation, resumes earlier agreed afternoon guild investigation. Routine authorized palace copying completed by available clerical staff while audience concludes, secretary certifies faithful transcriptions of the presented Kestrel document packet and records witness summaries; authenticity and merits of underlying evidence remain pending investigation. Original materials retained, no transfer of physical exhibits or new public release. Party takes ordinary midday meal hosted by Elara, goes to previously introduced guild organizer and quartermaster at 14:10, no personal fee. As prepared OR-CR-CA, accessible archive actual limited defense remit and contractor's signed seizure instruction are shown voluntarily by legitimate quartermaster; actual mandate concerns defense preparations and does not grant unilateral private custody/control of guild armory. Quartermaster reports his own refusal and continued custody of keys. Documents remain in guild custody; no new roll necessary to read disclosed plain terms or interview consenting source, no false claim of conclusive national political decision or Veyran link. Quartermaster willing to attest at meeting scheduled for approximately16:00 D315. Stop before V chooses approach or confrontation, no activation of hidden roster. D315~14:10 Caereth chartered-guild courtyard, adjacent records room. V/Elara/Mara/Cirren/Fenar physically present with district organizer and guild quartermaster after ending palace audience and ordinary midday meal at Elara's expense. D315 earlier authorized copying completed under supervision before departure: Crown retains one certified transcription set of presented original Kestrel documents plus recorded witness summaries; certification means faithful copies, not authentication of Veyran seals or official findings; V retains all originals, Mara retains notes, Fenar retains six sealed vials and silver-fitted instrument. No samples surrendered, public release, new Crown outcome or commitment. D316 defense consultation invitation remains available. Guild organizer arranged access per accepted quest; quartermaster shows actual Assembly authorization for defense preparations but no grant to private contractor of armory custody or command, and signed contractor instruction demanding transfer of armory keys and stock control. Quartermaster personally refused, still holds keys; no transfer made or attack yet. V learns documentary discrepancy directly, not a universal legal judgment or evidence of Veyr's involvement. Quartermaster willing to show documents at scheduled D315 late-afternoon public meeting (around16:00); organizer wants civilians safe and legitimate access maintained. V may approach contractor before meeting, arrange legitimate watch presence, attend with evidence, or other action. No NPC moved to combat positions yet, no fight, no milestone paid. Elara supports defending lawful collective authority and not obstructing genuine defense needs. V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi5/6 MP7/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers1/1 cloak+Luckstone attuned; Fenar59/59 AC14 HD6/6 Rage4/4 Shift3/3 MP6/6 inactive; Cirren51/51 AC18 HD6/6 full slots4/3/3 CD2/2 boots equipped; Mara/Elara/4 horses healthy. Rest5/6 food21/feed28 purse403gp4sp6cp conditional240gp sale unpaid. Crown commission active remaining300+1300, credentials V-held; Defense quest 833+1667 conditional rewards and negotiated benefits unearned. Marriage recognized, Elara standing representation accepted, Severin reply pending. Dice delegated until stop.
